content.comment_body: I would like to change the prefix in the payload when subscribing to data from [product_name]. Is it possible to modify the payload prefix before publishing using a ladder diagram in [product_name] Soft Comfort? For example, the message from [product_name] is: {"state":{"reported":{"var1":{"desc":"V-byte-0-2","value":[20]}}}}. I want the message to be: {"mydata":{"var1":{"desc":"V-byte-0-2","value":[20]}}}.
As far as I am aware, this is not possible unless you modify the software and firmware.

analysis.insight_summary: Users aim to change the MQTT payload prefix when sending data from [product_name] using [product_name] Soft Comfort, hoping for more flexible data formatting. However, experienced users confirm that such customization cannot be achieved within the current ladder diagram setup or available software options, limiting the ability to format published data to meet external system requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to directly modify or customize the MQTT payload structure in [product_name] Soft Comfort, specifically changing JSON prefixes before publishing data.
